content.introduction: On the earnings calendar for Leverage Shares, the companies scheduled to report earnings on October 26, 2026, are Cadence Design Systems (CDNS). On October 27, 2026, the companies scheduled to report earnings are PayPal Holdings (PYPG), SK Hynix (SKHX), Teradyne (TERG), Bloom Energy Corporation (BEG), Boeing Company (BOEG), NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NXPG), and Corning Incorporated (GLWG). On October 5, 2026, Aehr Test Systems (AEHG) is scheduled to report earnings. On October 13, 2026, UnitedHealth Group Incorporated (UNHG) is scheduled to report earnings. On October 14, 2026, ASML Holding N.V. (ASMG) is scheduled to report earnings. On October 15, 2026, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Ltd (TSMG) is scheduled to report earnings. On October 20, 2026, RTX Corporation (RTXG) and Galaxy Digital (GLGG) are scheduled to report earnings.

## How to use the Earnings Calendar?

TradingView’s Earnings Calendar shows the latest and upcoming earnings reports released by companies. As an important indicator of a company’s financial state, earnings per share are one of the most followed metrics among traders, so the calendar above can serve as a powerful tool for analysis.
